analysis_notes.visual_observations: All 8 videos: 1080x1920 @ 30fps, durations 47.5-56.0s. Hook text white/centered at 42% height — good contrast. Body subtitles gold (#F5C842) at 80% height, 4-word chunks. CTA last 3.5s. Double-image cut at 18s. Ken Burns visible 12%.
common_issues_found: Subtitle chunks are 4 words → too fast for older devotional audience (confirmed by corazon_001 comment 'textos van muy rapidos')
Hook text disappears at only 2.2s — not enough time for slow readers to process emotional question
CTA 'Comparte si Dios te habló hoy' is generic — misses comment seeding opportunity (no 'AMÉN' prompt)
Verse label (top-left) shows topic category ('ANSIEDAD', 'SANACIÓN') but NOT the bible verse reference — missed credibility signal
dormir_001 and soledad_001 share identical fondo_ai_night_stars.jpg background — visual repetition risk if uploaded same week
tiempos_dificiles_001 is longest at 56.0s — subtitle chunks likely more compressed (less time per word)
Background fondo_ai_galilee_storm.jpg (tiempos_dificiles) has high detail oil-painting texture → subtitles at bottom can blend with wave texture
manana_001 hook 'Empieza tu día con esta oración' is an instruction, not a question — lower emotional hook power vs. the other 7

observations: Hook '¿El miedo no te deja respirar?' — excellent emotional trigger, white centered text good contrast on clouds
Body subtitle gold on clouds bg at 15s: 'confiar en ti aunque' — gold readable but no stroke outline visible from frames, relies on shadow only
4-word chunks are fast for a 48s prayer with ~120 words → ~30 chunks → ~1.3s per chunk average
No AMÉN prompt in CTA — leaves engagement on the table

quick_wins.title: Respetar puntuación al partir chunks
quick_wins.change: In core/shorts_render.py function build_subtitle_segments(), after splitting into chunks by word count, add a second pass that avoids splitting immediately after a period unless chunk is already >= 5 words. Specifically: after building `chunks`, merge any chunk that ends with '.' where next chunk starts with lowercase into the previous chunk if combined < 8 words.
quick_wins.impact: subtitle coherence — viewers read meaning not words. Prevents 'Pero' / 'Y' appearing alone or after mid-sentence periods.
